c74object.name: lp.scampf
c74object.digest: Scale, map and limit numbers (float output)
c74object.description: lp.scampf scales and offsets numbers and can limit the result to a range by clipping, wrapping, reflecting or splitting off out-of-range values. Output is floating point.

objarg.name: limit
objarg.digest: clip, wrap, reflect, split or stet (default)

method.name: float
method.description: In the left inlet: Value to scale and offset (or map). In the 2nd inlet: Scale factor (input range low when mapping). In the 3rd inlet: Offset (input range high when mapping). In the 4th inlet: Output range lower bound. In the 5th inlet: Output range upper bound. In the 6th inlet: Curvature.

method.name: int
method.digest: Value to scale and offset (or map) (left inlet)
method.description: Value to scale and offset (or map) (left inlet).

method.name: map
method.description: Set scaling so that an input range maps to an output range: map in-min in-max out-min out-max.

method.name: reflect
method.digest: Reflect out-of-range values back into the range
method.description: Reflect out-of-range values back into the range.

method.name: split
method.digest: Send out-of-range values out the right outlet
method.description: Send out-of-range values out the right outlet.

method.name: stet
method.digest: Do not limit the output range
method.description: Do not limit the output range.

method.name: sym
method.digest: Set a symmetric curvature for the mapping
method.description: Set a symmetric curvature for the mapping.

method.name: tattle
method.digest: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same)
method.description: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same).

method.name: wrap
method.digest: Wrap out-of-range values around the range
method.description: Wrap out-of-range values around the range.

entry.name: float
entry.digest: Right outlet: Out-of-range values with split; otherwise the number of corrected values
